name: tracegov
description: AI-powered QR file tracking system for Nepal's Ward Offices

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,ai -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend" "npm run dev:ai"
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd ai-service && python3.11 -m venv .venv && ./.venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
